text: 持刀者虽然吃了一惊，但仍镇定地完成致命一击，随后才逃跑。可怜的男孩还没弄清发生了什么，镰刀便闪过，伯纳德的头颅应声落下。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 201
text: Although startled, the blade-wielder has the presence of mind to complete his deadly work before running. Before the doomed boy understands what is happening, the sickle flashes and Bernard’s head drops free.
